1479-3756-8337.description:
Play Izzet Boilerworks.
When Izzet Boilerworks enters the battlefield, it, M'Ress, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Izzet Boilerworks trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the M'Ress trigger, creating two 1/1 red Officer creature tokens
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Izzet Boilerworks from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Izzet Boilerworks enters the battlefield, it and M'Ress trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

1170-1770-3389-5954-8345.description:
Cast Flickering Ward by paying {W}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When Overlord of the Hauntwoods enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens, which enter untapped due to Warp Speed.
Resolve the Flickering Ward spell.
Activate the two Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {W}{W}.
Activate Flickering Ward by paying {W}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

147-728-5100.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
147-728-5100.description:
Cast Return Upon the Tide by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Return Upon the Tide.
Holding priority, activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, putting a +1/+1 counter on Grimgrin and untapping it.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Return Upon the Tide
Resolve the Return Upon the Tide copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

1170-4030-5131-6797--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-4030-5131-6797--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Starnheim Courser.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the artifact, putting a +1/+1 counter on Phantom Train and causing it to become a creature until end of turn
Repeat.

4050-6249-7920--5.easyPrerequisites: The persist creature does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
4050-6249-7920--5.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, it and Tresserhorn's Lord trigger.
Resolve the Tresserhorn's Lord trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the persist creature's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters the battlefield, Olivia triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature and causing you to discard a card.
Repeat.

1594-4200-6867-7055.description:
Cast Appa by paying {W}{W}
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Icewind Stalwart with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Icewind Stalwart from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Icewind Stalwart enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

1409-3099-3755-4359.description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by tapping it, adding {U}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, its soulbond ability triggers, repairing it with another creature.
Repeat.

1619-2438-4605-5542-6143.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
1619-2438-4605-5542-6143.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Feywild Caretaker from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Feywild Caretaker enters, it triggers once and Preston triggers twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Feywild Caretaker.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Feywild Caretaker that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Feywild Caretaker token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Feywild Caretaker token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Feywild Caretaker that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the Feywild Caretaker trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
1619-2438-4605-5542-6143.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

304-1978-7685.description:
Animate Arc Reactor using Tough Cookie.
Activate Arc Reactor by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Arc Reactor.
Repeat from step 2.

3240-5686-6462-7396.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Nether Traitor.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Kheru Goldkeeper and Quintorius, History Chaser triggers, creating a Treasure token and creature token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

1394-2034-2060-7038-7061.description:
Play Power Depot, which will enter with a +1/+1 counter on it due to its modular ability
Cast Toph either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Toph enters, it triggers, earthbending Power Depot and putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Power Depot equal to the mana spent to cast Toph, increased by Solid Ground.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Power Depot.
When Power Depot dies, its modular ability and Toph trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting the +1/+1 counters that were on Power Depot onto Crystalline Crawler, increased by Solid Ground.
Resolve the Toph trigger, returning Power Depot from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped. Power Depot will enter with a +1/+1 counter on it due to its modular ability
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Toph. Choose to return Toph from your graveyard to the command zone.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {R/G}.
Repeat step 9 until you have enough mana to cast Toph.
Repeat from step 2.

489-586-2511-5258-5618.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

3532-5078-5645-6822.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Lyla triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more +1/+1 counters on it

2034-3192-6872.description:
Activate Ulasht by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating a creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature token, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature token dies, Lord Feng triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Ulasht.
Repeat.

703-2034-4394-5929.description:
Cast Everquill Phoenix for its mutate cost by paying {3}{R}, mutating it over or under a non-Human creature you control.
Everquill Phoenix triggers, creating a Feather artifact token.
Cast Astral Dragon by paying {6}{U}{U}.
When Astral Dragon enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating two copies of the Feather token that are 3/3 Dragon creatures.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Astral Dragon, adding {C}{C}.
Activate a Feather by paying {1} and sacrificing it, returning Astral Dragon from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 4.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-2557-5742-5743.description:
Activate Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty by discarding Gilded Assault Cart.
Mary Read and Anne Bonny triggers, creating two tapped Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty ability.
Activate Gilded Assault Cart by sacrificing two Treasures, returning Gilded Assault Cart from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

4985-5078-5642.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0}.
Echoes of Eternity triggers, creating a copy of the Sensei's Divining Top spell.
Resolve both Sensei's Divining Top spells.
Activate the nontoken Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Activate the token Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw Sensei's Divining Top, and causing you to put the token Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

1242-1323-1432-3143.notablePrerequisites:
Experiment Kraj and Xavier Sal do not have summoning sickness.
Cinderhaze Wretch and Ioreth of the Healing House each have at least one +1/+1 counter on them.
You control at least one creature token.
1242-1323-1432-3143.description:
Activate Experiment Kraj using Cinderhaze Wretch's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Activate Xavier Sal's first ability by tapping it and removing a -1/-1 counter from Experiment Kraj, creating a copy of any creature token you control.
Activate Experiment Kraj using Ioreth of the Healing House's ability by tapping it, untapping Xavier Sal.
Repeat.
1242-1323-1432-3143.notes: You can optionally use Ioreth of the Healing House's second ability instead.

1651-2797-3129-4659.description:
Activate Retrofitter Foundry's second ability by paying {2} and tapping it, creating two 1/1 Servo artifact creature tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the Servos, untapping Retrofitter Foundry.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may instead use Retrofitter Foundry's first ability to untap it and get infinite untapped Servo tokens.

188-1857-2178.notablePrerequisites:
All Equipments and/or Auras attached to the same creature.
That creature does not have summoning sickness.
188-1857-2178.description:
Activate the creature by tapping it, dealing damage to an opponent's creature.
The opponent's creature dies due to deathtouch, triggering the second ability granted by Thornbite Staff, untapping your creature.
Repeat until all opponents' creatures die.
Repeat each time a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

2966-3253-4268-4613.notablePrerequisites:
Zopandrel has at least one indestructible counter on it, and at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
You control at least one additional permanent.
2966-3253-4268-4613.description:
Activate Zopandrel using Myojin of Blooming Dawn's ability by removing an indestructible counter from it, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token for each permanent you control.
When the Spirits enter the battlefield, Kor Celebrant triggers that many times, causing you to gain that much life.
Activate Zopandrel by paying 4 life and sacrificing two Spirits, putting an indestructible counter on it.
Repeat.
If you control at least two additional permanents as the combo starts, this combo nets infinite lifegain and creature tokens.

61-2034-3374-4226.notablePrerequisites: Callous Sell-Sword does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
61-2034-3374-4226.description:
Cast Glamerdye by paying {1}{U}, changing all instances of "white" on Antler Skulkin to "black" until end of turn.
Activate Antler Skulkin by paying {2}, giving Callous Sell-Sword persist until end of turn.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Callous Sell-Sword, adding {C}{C}.
When Callous Sell-Sword dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Callous Sell-Sword enters the battlefield with an additional +1/+1 counter on it for each creature you controlled that died this turn.
Repeat from step 2.

1636-4050-4319-4424.notablePrerequisites: You control another nontoken nonartifact creature.
1636-4050-4319-4424.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another nontoken nonartifact creature, adding one mana of any color.
When the creature dies, Missy's first ability triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a 2/2 Cyberman artifact creature.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Activate Skirk Alarmist by tapping it, turning the creature face up.
Repeat.

3817-4050-5170.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 3.
3817-4050-5170.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Sister Hospitaller, adding one mana of any color.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Junji, adding one mana of any color.
When Junji dies, it triggers, returning Sister Hospitaller from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Sister Hospitaller enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield, and causing you to gain 5 life.
Repeat.

1030-2034-2423.notablePrerequisites: Othelm does not have summoning sickness.
1030-2034-2423.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Bounding Krasis, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Othelm by paying {2} and tapping it, returning Bounding Krasis from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Bounding Krasis enters the battlefield, untapping Othelm.
Repeat.
